title: Surreal Mystic Eye Realm
description: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting featuring multiple oversized symbolic eyes. In the foreground, a giant eye contains a small boat with a figure rowing under a crescent moon. A blue-skinned king with a golden crown sits beside an open spellbook and a floating orb of eyes. In the background, a cloaked figure carries a lantern along a path, while a giant rat with a ship on its back stands near a massive red moon containing a green iris eye.
prompt: Surreal symbolic fantasy scene with multiple mystical eyes. A giant foreground eye holds a small boat with a rower inside a swirling pupil under a crescent moon. A blue king wearing a golden crown sits at a table with an open grimoire and a levitating sphere covered in eyes. A hooded figure with a lantern walks a winding path. A giant rat carries a sailing ship on its back. A massive red moon contains a detailed green eye. Shelves of glowing potions, scales, candles, and occult symbols fill the composition in rich detailed style.
